title: Sales Executive (B2B Logistics)

reasons.love: Partly commercial; much of the role is back-office support.
reasons.good_at: Some overlap via F26 (reporting); the domain experience the JD wants is not evidenced.
reasons.needs: Small team with no visible training or growth path.
reasons.paid: THB 25,000-32,000 per month stated in the posting -> about THB 28,500/month.

summary: Weak on pay and growth compared with the graduate programmes on the board.
jd_text: Ninja Van Thailand is hiring for Sales Executive (B2B Logistics) in Bangkok, Thailand. You will work with cross-functional teams, analyse sales and customer data, prepare weekly reports and present recommendations to managers. Requirements: bachelor's degree in any field (2026-2027 graduates welcome); good command of English and Thai; strong Excel; a team player who learns quickly. We offer structured training, mentoring and a clear career path.
